title: Two 17-Year-Olds Face Capital Murder Charges After Fatal Plano Shooting - NewsBreak
text:
By cdoubt ,
2 hours ago
Plano police vehicles and emergency lights line a neighborhood street following a fatal alleyway shooting on Middle Cove Drive. (Credit: Local News Screenshot) A fatal shooting in a suburban Plano Texas neighborhood has drawn a heavy law enforcement response and left two teenagers facing adult capital murder charges. The incident has brought localized focus to the community as police quickly moved to take suspects into custody.
The Big Picture
The Incident: Plano police officers responded to emergency calls regarding a shooting at approximately 5:30 p.m. in an alleyway in the 900 block of Middle Cove Drive. The Victim: Authorities discovered 17-year-old Daniel Ariel Rosales suffering from a fatal gunshot wound. Paramedics pronounced him dead at the scene. The Arrests: Following a swift investigation, detectives arrested 17-year-old Chauncey Kentrell Harris of Little Elm and 17-year-old Na’Treveon Deon Ward of Plano. Both have been formally charged as adults with capital murder. Na’Treveon Deon Ward (right) and Chauncey Kentrell Harris (left), both 17, face adult capital murder charges in connection with the death of Daniel Ariel Rosales. (Credit: Plano Police Department) Between the Lines
The Escalation: According to the police arrest affidavit, the fatal encounter took place during an attempted firearm sale. Investigators state that Harris shot Rosales while the victim was counting money, and the suspects allegedly used counterfeit currency to make the incident look like a staged robbery before fleeing with the weapon. Community Impact: Local residents expressed alarm online following the rare display of violent crime on a residential block, prompting community discussions regarding teen safety and regional crime trends. What’s Next
Both suspects are currently being held in custody on capital murder charges. The Plano Police Department’s Crimes Against Persons Unit continues to process evidence as the case moves toward formal legal proceedings.
15 Minutes of Murder Producer’s Quote: “When capital murder charges land on teenagers in a neighborhood known for top-tier schools and quiet cul-de-sacs, it disrupts the entire community’s sense of security. It leaves families demanding answers about how a routine evening could turn into an execution. One of the scariest things we see at 15 Minutes of Murder is the recurring theme that you sometimes never know what might be going on right next door, no matter how perfect a community may seem.”
